'''Keriin Haslip''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Garos IV]] who served as a member of the [[Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification]]. She had a son, [[West Haslip|West]], who married [[Nieka Haslip|Nieka]] and had a child with her, [[Dair Haslip|Dair]]. She raised Dair after the death of his parents in [[11 BBY/Legends|11 BBY]].<ref name="TP" />

Keriin was an influential person on Garos IV, owner of [[Mining/Legends|mines]] on the planet. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established an official presence on Garos IV in [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]], she was forced to sell her mines. This persuaded her to join the [[Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification|Garos resistance]].<ref name="TP" />

When [[Jos Mayda]], her grandson's best friend, was killed by two [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]], she introduced Dair to the resistance and convinced him to enter at the Imperial [[Raithal Academy/Legends|academy]] as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]].<ref name="TP" />
